pr31_notes.title: Let the morning huddle add and check off tasks
pr31_notes.state: open, not merged, mergeable_state dirty as of this read
pr31_notes.data: Tasks come from public.driven_tasks (text, owner, category: General on insert, priority: Medium, due, done, attachments). HuddleTasks.list() maps rows to {id, text, owner, due, done, status}. Dates are America/Chicago calendar days, YYYY-MM-DD. Overdue = open and due < today in Chicago. First three non-done rows after sort (Overdue, then Open, then Done; then by due) are the meeting Top 3.
pr31_notes.people_constant: HuddleTasks.PEOPLE is currently Patrick, Annie, Rich, Landon, Amber. Dan is not in that list, so his tasks would not count in summarize() and would not appear in the Add task datalist. Add Dan before this map is wired in.
pr31_notes.where_to_add: Add a 'Tasks by role' section immediately after the existing #taskAccountability block that huddle-tasks.js sectionHtml() renders (the Task / Owner / Due / Status table and Add task form live there; renderBoard() in huddle.js injects it after the sales scoreboard). Keep sales first, then today's to-do table, then the role map so missed dates are visible every huddle without replacing Top 3.
pr31_notes.overdue_highlight: Reuse statusOf() and the existing .pill.overdue / .pair.miss colors (--red #FF6B6B, --miss #3a1212). Highlight any role-map row whose status is Overdue, or whose due date is before today and status is not Done. Optional: filter chips for Rollout week and Type; a Type badge for Judgment checkpoint.
pr31_notes.data_hook: Do not change driven_tasks shape in this pass. Preferred hook is to load this file (task_role_map.json) or a copy in the repo and render it in a new HuddleRoleTasks helper, or later add type, bot_automation, rollout_week, and milestone columns to driven_tasks if the team wants check-off on these rows. This map was not written to the repo or the PR.
